text:
Rina Shah: FYI saw a jump in fncall schema rejects for billing-service after the strict-validator toggle. most were routed to 'degen' and console route view shows zero samples which makes triage impossible.
Omar Khalid: region and model? any sample logs?
Rina Shah: us-central / model=rpc-lite-3. log: `2026-02-22T16:12:05Z invoke=inv-900 route=degen error=validate_fncall missing 'charge.amount' quota_tag=reserved-us`
Priya Desai: sampler job is known to filter on `route_type='tool'` instead of including degen route_id; it drops those examples. opened PR to fix join predicates.
Omar Khalid: billing side: are validation rejects being counted against reserved capacity? customers will complain if false positives spike usage.
Priya Desai: metering pipeline currently zeroes route_id for reject responses. filing MET-4120 to preserve route_id.
Rina Shah: short-term mitigation: can we return structured reject info in the response so console can at least display reason without samples? something like header `x-rw-fn-reject: schema:charge.amount` and a tiny JSON blob with `field` + `hint`.
Omar Khalid: fine. ops note: ensure proxies don't strip the header and metering preserves it downstream.
infra-bot: deployment event: strict-validator canary -> hosts v-882; status 1/3 applied
Priya Desai: opened PRs: 9182 (sampler join fix), 9183 (metering preserve route), 9184 (structured-reject header). Dashboard ticket RD-1518 for console badge.
Rina Shah: product asks for a "how to fix" snippet in the flyout. filed CON-2205.
Omar Khalid: I'll watch reject rate and revert canary if it crosses 0.7% for 10m. keep updates here.
Rina Shah: thanks — will post sample counts after sampler fix merges.
